law: Mail IS just an envelope. SMTP = electron shuttle. Redox = oxidation-reduction = electron transfer = email.

inbound.action: Receive mail → parse envelope → store in Gaia/mail/inbox/ as .eml

outbound.action: Compose → sign DKIM → send through port 587

spec.before_delete_vps: SSH to 157.230.3.183, pull all existing mail: scp -r root@157.230.3.183:/var/mail/ Gaia/mail/archive/

redox_biology: Oxidation = lose electron = SEND mail. Reduction = gain electron = RECEIVE mail. The mailbox is the electron cloud. The envelope is the orbital shell. The address is the quantum number.
